title: Resolve disputed global-role and paid-after-expiry contracts
body: Evidence report59 at87a2408: permission matrix allows global OWNER/ADMIN but tenantScope allows only no-org ADMIN; matrix groups promoter cancel with confirm but current cancel controller treats promoter as buyer. Expiry creates15-minute hold, confirm lacks expiry check; no approved paid-after-expiry automatic recovery contract. Needed only for disputed positives/expiry behavior in65/68, not ordinary scoped-negative tests. Recommendation preserve global ADMIN-only current helper; no global OWNER expansion, promoter confirm scoped and cancel own-order only until explicit approval; late paid order enters explicit manual reconciliation without automatic financial refund. No financial action or permission expansion occurs from this ticket. Daniel decision required; ordinary source/mock work continues. No new runtime question:57 already owns environment access.
